##### Project general facts

Wyndham Residences Al Marjan Island by Divine One Group is a refined branded residential project where world-class hospitality seamlessly blends with everyday living, creating a calm and welcoming atmosphere defined by comfort and connection. The development offers a thoughtfully curated collection of studio and 1-bedroom apartments, each designed to feel intuitive, elegant, and effortlessly livable. With the trusted legacy of Wyndham behind it, the project delivers a lifestyle that feels both elevated and reassuring, where every detail reflects care, warmth, and timeless appeal.

The amenities are exceptionally well-balanced, combining relaxation, wellness, and social experiences into one cohesive lifestyle offering. Residents can enjoy a state-of-the-art gym, yoga and Pilates studios, spa with sauna and cold plunge, a family water park, and beautifully designed social lounges and outdoor retreats. Rooftop highlights such as an adults-only pool, jacuzzi, padel court, and outdoor cinema elevate everyday living, while concierge, housekeeping, and curated services ensure effortless comfort and convenience at all times.

The residences are fully furnished and delivered as turnkey homes, allowing for immediate, stress-free living from the moment of arrival. Interiors feature a harmonious blend of porcelain flooring, travertine stone, and rich wood finishes, complemented by premium integrated appliances and carefully selected accessories. Every home is equipped with essentials from kitchenware to bedding, enhanced by smart-home features and refined design touches, creating a space that feels complete, elegant, and perfectly aligned with modern lifestyle expectations.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Marjan Island is a stunning man-made archipelago located in the emirate of Ras Al Khaimah. It is one of the most prominent tourist destinations in the region, known for its picturesque beaches, luxurious resorts, and upscale residential developments. Al Marjan Island is situated along the Arabian Gulf coastline and offers breathtaking views of the sea. The island is shaped like a coral reef and is made up of four primary coral-shaped islands, connected by a central boulevard.

One of the main highlights of Al Marjan Island is its pristine white sandy beaches that stretch across 5.4 kilometers. Visitors can indulge in various beach activities, including sunbathing, swimming, and water sports such as jet skiing and paddleboarding. The crystal-clear waters of the Arabian Gulf provide an ideal setting for water enthusiasts.

Al Marjan Island boasts a collection of luxurious hotels and resorts, offering world-class amenities and services. These accommodations cater to both leisure and business travelers, providing a range of options to suit different preferences and budgets. Many of the hotels and resorts on the island feature stunning architecture and provide access to private beaches, swimming pools, spas, and gourmet dining options.
